subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Is deterministic MemoryIndexManager regression proof enough for this memory_search fallback recovery, or should merge wait for redacted live Gateway/provider outage proof?
rationale: The code path is source-backed and tested, but the external-PR proof gate is not met because the contributor only provided mocked provider-boundary tests and explicitly lacks a live Gateway/Ollama outage harness.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing Gateway memory_search falling back during a primary outage, recovering the primary, and returning results afterward.

options.title: Apply proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the deterministic manager-level proof and own the residual live-provider risk before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the issue
options.body: Keep the PR open but defer merge until the canonical issue has a maintainer-provided live reproduction harness or another proven fix path.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing Gateway memory_search falling back during a primary outage, recovering the primary, and returning results afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest provider-state refactor history on the touched helper boundary and is a plausible owner for deciding proof sufficiency.
